description: Review/approval layer over data/source_registry.json. Records whether a manual edition's EXTRACTED CONTENT has been compared against the original document by a human and approved for use as direct AI evidence. Document-level provenance (file authenticity, checksum, page count) is tracked separately in source_registry.json and is NOT the same thing as content approval.
notes: approval_state is deliberately conservative. Everything defaults to unapproved
and is promoted one edition at a time by a named human.
As of 2026-09-01 a newer edition (the 2026-09-01 HWP pair) is registered
'needs_review' pending human content review. The 2026-07-31 pair REMAINS
approved and current. The new edition is staged under 'pending_review_editions' in
docs/source-manuals/source_manifest.json, deliberately NOT in 'current':
'current' is reserved for approved editions. Promotion happens when
the reviewer records the approval here AND, in the same change,
moves it into manifest 'current'.
As of 2026-09-18 the stay manual has a further edition: the 2026-09-18 배포용 HWP
(stay_manual_2026_09_18_hwp), the original of the already-registered
stay_manual_2026_09_18_pdf. It is likewise 'needs_review'. It supersedes NOTHING
automatically: 2026-07-31 remains the approved and current stay edition, and the
2026-09-01 HWP remains staged. The HWP and PDF of the same edition keep separate
locators (paragraph vs page) and their figures must never be merged.
As of 2026-08-09 the two 2026-07-31 HWP editions are 'approved' (reviewer
recorded per document). Every other edition remains unapproved: the older
structured extracts are auto-parsed (see 'auto-parsed item' markers in
backend/data/manual_grounding/*.json) and were never certified line-by-line.
An approval covers the BODY TEXT of that edition. It does not lift the
per-document table_extraction_warnings — 별표/첨부서류 tables are flattened to
paragraph text in every extraction here and must never be read as structured
tables, approved or not.
Consequence, enforced by backend/services/manual_registry.py:
- 'parsed' / 'needs_review' content is SEARCHABLE and is labelled 검토 전.
- Only 'approved' content may back a direct assertion in an AI answer.
Promoting an edition to 'approved' is a human action: compare the extracted
sections against the original document, record the reviewer and timestamp
here, and open a PR. Nothing in the automated pipeline may set 'approved'.
A missing or corrupt copy of this file fails CLOSED — every document falls
back to needs_review — so a broken index can never widen what the assistant
is allowed to assert.
As of 2026-10-16 the owner chose the reference editions: stay 2026-09-18 and visa 2026-09-01
(both containers of each: HWP and PDF). They are 'approved' (reviewer recorded per document)
and current; the 2026-07-31 pair is 'superseded'. The 2026-09-01 stay HWP was never approved
and is superseded by 2026-09-18. The approval records an edition decision, not a line-by-line
certification of every structured extract; see audits/manual-edition-2026-09-promotion/README.md.

table_extraction_warnings: Tables are rendered from the converter's HTML/pipe tables as '열이름: 값' or '행 제목: 값' lines, with rowspans carried. Header detection is heuristic (short all-<th> leading rows); multi-level headers can be joined imperfectly, so a table row must be checked against the cited PDF page before it is quoted as a requirement.
